verdict.rationale: gstack's source is publicly readable. It is hosted on GitHub, installed via git clone, and contributors can work directly from a checkout of the repo. However, nothing in the evidence names a license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented open-source license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license statement), and independent confirmation of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: It symlinks your repo into the local `.claude/skills/` directory so Claude Code reads skills straight from your checkout.
